title: Prove an explicit finite-depth leaf tail bound (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with a finite exact numerical certificate. For PR4467's fixed historical raw-p7 law, every depth G>=11000 and lockstep offset delta in [0,log(5)] obeys

```text
Pr(Y >= x | survival) <= min(1, 5 exp(-lambda x)),  x >= 0.
E[(Y-L)_+ | survival] <= (5/lambda) exp(-lambda L),  L >= 0.
```

Here lambda=t-alpha is the predecessor's tilt gap. The second inequality bounds the error from clipping the actual leaf-depth mean, retaining the independent unconditioned terminal rank. This partially answers Ryanson Jonathan / pinterbanget's [PR4467 open question 2](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4467). DLamdata's [PR6118](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6118), cited at `6310550e932de70243fc2aaab6f4885688b6fe21`, supplies qualitative saturation and the exact leaf-measure identification. The new step is the explicit finite-depth envelope and truncation constants.

Only `research/direct-flow-finite-tail/` is added. The result is produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Ryanson Jonathan, DLamdata, zxv's direct flow, Cinna Davis's refined induction, Jacob Alan Sussman's lockstep compiler, and the classical Berry–Esseen/change-of-measure ingredients. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19241861).

## Evidence

Before: the cited saturation proof supplies an unspecified tail constant and onset, and expressly leaves quantitative bounds open. After: the proof gives constant 5 at every G>=11000. Exact rational gates certify a denominator coefficient above 37/4 and numerator coefficient below 2098/49, whose ratio is 8392/1813<5.

From the repository root, with CPython 3.12.15 and the standard library:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B research/direct-flow-finite-tail/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -O -B research/direct-flow-finite-tail/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/direct-flow-finite-tail
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/direct-flow-finite-tail --check-source-history
```

Reviewers can substitute their CPython 3.12 path. Normal and optimized commands passed in 0.18 and 0.19 seconds locally, each with `PASS_DIRECT_FLOW_FINITE_TAIL`, 208 exact tilt/clipping fixtures and six rejecting controls. Registered replay passed in 0.72 seconds; each registered check is below one second and its timeout is 120 seconds. Development mode with warnings as errors passed. Committed bytes and source ancestry passed at `9be0bd96279cd66098a9d536ffd0092fd771550a`.

The official eight-file committed export and explicit input-coverage check passed. An isolated optimized Git-free replay with empty PATH and read-only exported files passed; all nine exported files including the export manifest remained byte-identical. Direct runs emit generated SHA256-bound receipts and write nothing into the checkout. No predecessor code executes.

## Limitations

This establishes neither a Bahadur–Rao asymptotic nor its error term, a decreasing convergence error, stable full-flow shares, a numerical induction ceiling, a native supplier or new kappa. The law is historical; the selected PR6030 result and five assumptions are unchanged. The Berry–Esseen theorem, elementary pi bounds and cited leaf-measure identification remain mathematical inputs. The universal argument is written, not proof-kernel checked. No selected cold replay, full predecessor replay, physical implementation, Lean or Docker was run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

Can an effective nonlattice interval local-limit estimate give a decreasing error relative to the limiting law or mean? Start by combining its remainder with this finite tail envelope. The missing input is a quantitative local-limit remainder.

## Related open work

- [PR6118](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6118) proves qualitative saturation for the same fixed law. This adds an explicit finite-depth upper envelope and clipping-error control, without re-verifying its saturation certificate or claiming its sharper parameter bounds.
- [PR6125](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6125) proves the three-regime asymptotic power-tariff transition for the same law. It leaves finite-depth convergence rates outside its scope; this result gives a uniform finite-depth probability inequality. No extra computation was run to compare its numbers.

Completion refresh examined this account's 11 other open PRs created since the advance CLAIM, #6121–#6132 excluding this PR. Only #6125 studies the same fixed leaf law and is listed above. No additional numerical comparison was run.

## CI notes

**Uncertified by CI.** At head `9be0bd96279cd66098a9d536ffd0092fd771550a`, [run 40692886731](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40692886731) failed `plan` in Onboarding helper tests. The package replay was skipped and **did not run in CI**.

The two failures are inherited from canonical main `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`, the PR6030 kappa admission pushed with `[skip ci]`. The selected record changed without matching the existing documentation synchronization tests:

- `test_research_current_status.CurrentStatusTests.test_current_section_matches_selected_record` expects the literal `**0.003125804**` in `docs/research/current-status.md`. The document instead bolds `**0.003125804 = 781451/250000000**`, so that exact substring is absent.
- `test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record` expects `make frontier6030-verify` in `docs/ci-verification.md`. That document's current section still describes PR5599 and `make frontier5599-verify`.

The failure log ends with `FAILED (failures=2, skipped=23)`. The same two failures appear on [PR6120 run 40691776027](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40691776027), whose failed-job log was read for comparison. They are unrelated to this isolated package. No documentation repair or new push was made. Local verification remains as recorded above; no hosted package result is claimed. A maintainer must re-run CI after main's documentation is fixed.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. The six-file research package changes no shared code, frozen predecessor files or selected-frontier record.
